description: This file contains functions related to checking and displaying new code changes, including retrieving commit ranges and showing diffs in VSCode.

methods.name: findLast
methods.description: Finds the last index in an array that satisfies the predicate.

methods.name: getCommitRangeForNewCompletion
methods.description: Retrieves the range of commits for a new code completion, based on message history and checkpoint data.

methods.name: seeNewChanges
methods.description: Displays the differences between commits in VSCode, handling empty changes and errors.
